name: Sphere Rendering with Thickness
aliases: Hollow Sphere Rendering with Thickness Clipping
definition: Renders a sphere with a specified thickness (shell) by checking grid points against the sphere's inner and outer radii.
summary: Sphere Rendering with Thickness renders a hollow shell by voxelizing points between inner and outer radii, differing from solid rendering by excluding the core and from triangle methods by using a spherical coordinate system.
